articles.summary: Celtic stay four clear, Hearts respond after a hard week and Motherwell's slide continues.
articles.body:
Radio Scotland , · 26 Oct 2026 , · 25 mins

Celtic maintained their four-point lead at the top of the Premiership with a hard-fought victory over Hibs, while Hearts bounced back from a difficult week with an important win against Motherwell. Stevie Miller is joined by Kevin Thomson and Conor Sammon to analyse Celtic's performance, discuss the struggles of big-money striker Kasper Høgh and assess whether there are signs of progress at Easter Road despite another defeat for Hibs. The panel also looks at Hearts' encouraging response under Wouter Vrancken, Rangers' impressive attacking form, Dundee United's thrilling win over Aberdeen and mounting concerns for Motherwell after a sixth consecutive league loss. articles.title: Após vitória de Lula, Caiado declara que acreditava em renovação | G1
articles.standfirst: Coletiva aconteceu em Goiânia neste domingo (25). Daniel Vilela (MDB) falou que a votação das urnas é soberana.
articles.summary: Coletiva aconteceu na Praça Cívica, em Goiânia, neste domingo (25). Daniel Vilela falou que a votação das urnas é soberana.
articles.body:
Após a confirmação da vitória de Lula na eleição presidencial, o governador Ronaldo Caiado ( PSD ) declarou, durante entrevista coletiva, em Goiânia , neste domingo (25), que apostava em uma renovação no país, mas que "como democratas, nos curvamos à decisão da maioria" . Daniel Vilela ( MDB ) classificou o resultado das urnas como soberano e manifestou a expectativa de que o presidente eleito promova as transformações necessárias para a população .

"Uma renovação. Era esse o ponto que todos nós lutamos favoravelmente a ele. Era buscar essa virada de página. Acreditamos nessa ideia. Mas nós, eh, como democratas que somos, nos curvamos à decisão da maioria e a decisão, eh, da apuração. Essa sempre foi a nossa característica", disse Caiado.

Daniel Vilela ressaltou que a decisão expressa pelas urnas é soberana e representa a vontade popular. Ele destacou a expectativa por uma postura diferente por parte do governo federal , defendendo uma gestão voltada para a responsabilidade fiscal.

Após vitória de Lula, Caiado declara que acreditava em renovação, mas 'como democratas, nos curvamos à decisão da maioria' — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera

Daniel também pontuou que o governo de Goiás manterá uma atuação firme na interlocução com a União para resguardar os interesses locais . Segundo Vilela, o estado continuará cobrando e reivindicando recursos e repasses junto à administração federal para garantir que as demandas e necessidades da população goiana sejam atendidas integralmente.

"A votação das urnas é soberana. Democratas como somos, temos que reconhecer o resultado das urnas, a vontade do povo brasileiro. O que nós queremos é que tenhamos um governo diferente, numa política de responsabilidade fiscal, numa política de não retaliação àqueles governos e estados que não são aliados políticos", falou Daniel.

Caiado apoiou Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno

O ex-candidato à Presidência Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) anunciou dia 6 de outubro apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) na disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial de 2026. O governador eleito de Goiás, Daniel Vilela (MDB), também formalizou adesão à campanha do senador.

Antes de oficializar a decisão, Caiado relembrou a relação de proximidade com Jair Bolsonaro e destacou que a aliança com Flávio atende a um desejo do ex-presidente.

articles.title: Destaque da campanha vitoriosa de Lula no 2° turno, Janones recusa título de 'o cara da virada': 'A gente reagiu à covardia' | G1
articles.standfirst: Muitas vezes questionado sobre as estratégias de campanha do primeiro turno, Sidônio Palmeira afirmou que não se sentiu pressionado após a derrota no 1º turno e se disse convicto sobre a sugestão de proibição das bets no Brasil.
articles.summary: Muitas vezes questionado sobre as estratégias de campanha do primeiro turno, Sidônio Palmeira afirmou que não se sentiu pressionado após a derrota no 1º turno e se disse convicto sobre a sugestão de proibição das bets no Brasil.
articles.body:
O deputado federal André Janones abraça o presidente Lula, reeleito neste domingo — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

Ao chegar ao Hotel Intercontinental para comemorar a reeleição do petista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva neste domingo (25), Janones afirmou que conseguiu criar o canal de Whatsapp "Exército do Lula", com mais de 10 milhões de seguidores, graças à missão de defender a democracia.

“Eu agradeço [o título de maior nome do 2º turno], mas o nome real desta eleição é Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. A energia vem dele, a força vem dele. Eu recebi a missão de canalizar isso. A energia nunca emanou de mim. Eu peguei a energia dele e, como se fosse um cano, canalizei essa energia para distribuir para o povo brasileiro”, afirmou.

“A gente reagiu à covardia. E mostrou que, da mesma forma que eles se reúnem para fazer o mal e assassinar reputações, a gente mostrou que é possível se unir para defender a democracia”, declarou.

Janones voltou a comparar Lula com o jogador Leonel Messi, da Seleção Argentina, e disse que ele não precisa usar as redes sociais e tem uma juventude inteira ‘para correr por ele’.

“Nós jogamos para o Messi. O Messi nunca deixou de ser gênio. Ele fala na seleção da Argentina: olha, eu não consigo correr mais, mas o restante eu faço. Os jovens disseram: eu corro por você. Eu dizia para o Lula: ‘O senhor não tem que aprender a usar rede social. O senhor já fez o que tinha que fazer. Nas redes sociais, nós correremos pelo senhor’. E foi isso que a gente fez”, declarou.

Janones após vitória de Lula — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

Sofre o fato de ganhar algum cargo no futuro governo Lula, Janones afirma que nunca teve esse tipo de conversa sobre cargos com o presidente reeleito e o PT e não almeja, por ora, esse agrado, como recompensa pelo trabalho no segundo turno.

“Nunca houve essa conversa. Em 2022, as pessoas diziam que o presidente Lula deveria ter me nomeado ministro. Ele não deveria porque uma condição [minha] em 2022 era que eu continuasse na Câmara dos Deputados. O meu compromisso é com a democracia e com o maior presidente que este país já teve”, afirmou.

Lula faz discurso da vitória em hotel na capital paulista — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

'Nós enfrentamos todos', diz marqueteiro

Principal nome do marketing da campanha vitoriosa de Lula (PT), o marqueteiro Sidônio Palmeira, ex-ministro-chefe da Secretaria de Comunicação Social do Brasil, comemorou neste domingo (25) a vitória do petista de virada no segundo turno.

“Acho que a gente voltou para esse segundo turno e pautou falando dos projetos do governo e discutindo o futuro do país. Nós enfrentamos todos: Trump, o tarifaço, os Bolsonaro querendo entregar o país. Tudo isso, e o provo compreendeu o que estava em jogo e deu a vitória ao presidente Lula”, afirmou ao g1 .

Muitas vezes questionado dentro e fora do PT sobre as estratégias de campanha do primeiro turno, que levaram Lula a chegar atrás de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Sidônio afirmou que não se sentiu pressionado após a derrota na primeira etapa e se disse convicto sobre a sugestão de proibição das bets no Brasil.

“Para ser sincero, eu não fui pressionado em nenhum momento. Eu sugeri ao presidente proibir as bets. E ele aceitou com a maior naturalidade. Não senti nenhuma pressão. A minha relação com o presidente é a mesma desde o primeiro turno e durante o período. Nós estivemos sempre do lado do povo brasileiro”, afirmou.

O marqueteiro da campanha de Lula, Sidônio Palmeira (PT) fala sobre a reeleição do presidente — Foto: Rodrigo Rodrigues/g1

articles.title: Líderes mundiais parabenizam Lula pela reeleição; veja repercussão | G1
articles.standfirst: O petista derrotou Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e se tornou o primeiro presidente da história do Brasil a ser eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.
articles.summary: O petista derrotou Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e se tornou o primeiro presidente da história do Brasil a ser eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.
articles.body:
Líderes mundiais parabenizaram neste domingo (25) o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) pela sua reeleição. Em uma eleição acirrada e marcada por uma virada inédita, Lula conquistou seu quarto mandato à frente do Palácio do Planalto .

Até a última atualização desta reportagem, o presidente dos Estados Unidos , Donald Trump , não havia comentado a vitória do petista. O presidente argentino, Javier Milei , também não havia se manifestado.

Às vésperas de completar 81 anos, o que ocorrerá na próxima terça-feira (27), o petista se tornou, ao derrotar Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), o primeiro presidente da história do Brasil a ser eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.

A confirmação da vitória de Lula foi feita pelo sistema do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), às 21h08, quando 97% das urnas já tinham sido apuradas. Àquela altura, Lula tinha 51,74% e Flávio tinha 48,26%.

"Meus parabéns, @LulaOficial , pela sua reeleição. A França e o Brasil têm muito a construir juntos. Diante dos grandes desafios do nosso tempo, reforcemos nossa parceria estratégica e façamos viver a amizade entre nossos dois países a serviço de um mundo mais justo."

Emmanuel Macron parabeniza Lula. — Foto: Reprodução/X

Pedro Sánchez, primeiro-ministro espanhol

“Uma grande vitória para Lula! O que aconteceu no Brasil acontecerá na Espanha. A retomada progressista global acaba de começar”.

Pedro Sánchez parabeniza Lula. — Foto: Reprodução/X

Guo Jiakun, porta-voz do Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China

“A China tomou conhecimento de que o Tribunal Superior Eleitoral do Brasil anunciou que o presidente Lula venceu o segundo turno das eleições gerais brasileiras e expressa suas felicitações”.

O porta-voz acrescentou que Pequim está “disposta a trabalhar com o Brasil para continuar avançando na construção de uma comunidade de futuro compartilhado entre China e Brasil”.

Ursula von der Leyen, presidente da Comissão Europeia

"Parabéns ao meu amigo @LulaOficial pela sua vitória eleitoral. A democracia e o multilateralismo venceram no Brasil. A parceria da Europa com o Brasil está florescendo. Permaneceremos ao seu lado nos anos vindouros.

Juntos, continuaremos trabalhando de perto por um comércio livre e aberto. Uma ordem global baseada em regras. E fortes ambições pelo nosso clima."

Ursula von der Leyen parabeniza Lula — Foto: Reprodução/X

Narendra Modi, primeiro-ministro da Índia

"Minhas mais calorosas felicitações ao meu caro amigo, Presidente Lula, pela sua notável vitória na reeleição.

Aguardo com expectativa trabalhar de perto com ele para aprofundar ainda mais e expandir a multifacetada Parceria Estratégica Índia-Brasil.

Juntos, continuaremos a fortalecer nossa cooperação em diversos setores, avançar as prioridades compartilhadas do Sul Global e trabalhar por um mundo mais inclusivo, equitativo e sustentável."

Narendra Modi parabeniza Lula. — Foto: Reprodução/X

"Parabéns pela reeleição no Brasil, presidente Lula.

As relações entre o Canadá e o Brasil avançaram graças à nossa parceria. Vamos aproveitar esta oportunidade para fortalecê-las ainda mais, juntos, criando novas oportunidades comerciais promissoras, protegendo o meio ambiente e garantindo maior prosperidade para nossas duas populações"

"Viva a democracia, o povo brasileiro venceu. Parabéns, presidente Lula!"

"Parabenizo o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva pela reeleição e cumprimento o povo brasileiro por esta jornada democrática.

Às vésperas do bicentenário de nossas relações diplomáticas, reafirmo nossa vontade de fortalecer a aliança estratégica, a integração, a cooperação e o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia que compartilhamos, em benefício de ambos os povos".

"Parabéns a Lula por esta vitória. Nossa região tem inimigos em comum, desafios compartilhados e muito a ganhar quando trabalhamos juntos".

"Acabo de conversar com o presidente do Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, e o parabenizei pelo resultado da eleição.

Chile e Brasil têm um futuro promissor em comum, e continuaremos trabalhando em uma agenda que fortaleça as relações entre nossos países nas áreas de integração econômica e combate ao crime organizado na região".

"Acabo de conversar com o presidente eleito do Brasil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, um amigo. Eu o parabenizei pela vitória e pela festa democrática que representa um processo eleitoral".

"Parabéns, Lula, por sua eleição como presidente do Brasil. Saúdo o povo brasileiro por esta grande jornada democrática. Paraguai e Brasil compartilham uma agenda comum de integração e desenvolvimento. Continuaremos trabalhando juntos pelo bem-estar de nossos povos".

"Parabenizo o presidente Lula por sua vitória. Bolívia e Brasil são países vizinhos e irmãos, unidos por uma história e desafios comuns. Continuaremos trabalhando juntos para fortalecer nossa relação e gerar mais oportunidades para nossas nações".

"Parabenizo o povo brasileiro por esta jornada democrática e, especialmente, o presidente Lula pela vitória! Seguiremos trabalhando juntos por nossos países".

"Que alegria imensa o povo brasileiro acaba de nos dar! Obrigado, querido, por nunca deixar de lutar, por manter viva a esperança de um mundo. Obrigado, presidente Lula, por seu compromisso com a humanidade. Nós te amamos! Com a esperança intacta…"

articles.title: Abstenção cai no 2º turno no estado de SP, e número de eleitores que não votaram recua em quase 1 milhão | G1
articles.standfirst: Índice passou de 22,54% para 19,81% no estado; votos nulos e brancos também diminuíram. Dados são do TRE-SP.
articles.summary: Índice passou de 22,54% para 19,81% no estado; votos nulos e brancos também diminuíram. Dados são do TRE-SP.
articles.body:
Eleitores votam no segundo turno no Colégio Miguel de Cervantes, no Morumbi, na Zona Sul — Foto: Felipe Rau/Estadão

A abstenção no estado de São Paulo caiu no segundo turno das eleições de 2026. O número de eleitores que deixaram de votar foi de 7.690.900 no primeiro turno, quando a taxa foi de 22,54%, para 6.759.202 no segundo, o equivalente a 19,81% do eleitorado apto.

A redução foi de 931.698 eleitores entre os dois turnos, e o percentual de abstenção recuou 2,73 pontos percentuais.

Na capital paulista, o movimento foi semelhante. A abstenção caiu de 23,39% no primeiro turno, quando 2.138.713 eleitores não compareceram às urnas, para 20,36% no segundo, com 1.861.898 de ausências. A diferença foi de 276.815 eleitores.

Além da queda na abstenção, os índices de votos nulos e brancos também diminuíram no estado e na capital na comparação entre os dois turnos.

No estado, os votos nulos passaram de 916.243 (3,47%) no primeiro turno para 716.331 (2,62%) no segundo. Já os votos em branco caíram de 632.801 (2,39%) para 389.606 (1,42%).

Na capital, os votos nulos recuaram de 278.977 (3,98%) para 216.904 (2,98%). Os votos em branco passaram de 174.614 (2,49%) para 104.890 (1,44%).

Entenda a diferença entre abstenção, voto em branco e voto nulo

As três situações têm significados diferentes. A abstenção corresponde à ausência do eleitor na votação. Já os votos em branco e nulos são registrados por quem comparece às urnas, mas não destina um voto válido a nenhum dos candidatos daquele cargo.

Abstenção: ocorre quando a pessoa apta a votar não comparece à votação. Na parcial das 21h20, a taxa era de 21,08% do eleitorado das seções já contabilizadas.

Voto em branco: é registrado quando o eleitor aperta a tecla “branco” e, depois, “confirma” na urna eletrônica. Até aquele horário, representava 1,84% dos votos registrados para presidente.

Voto nulo: ocorre quando o eleitor digita um número que não corresponde a nenhum candidato ao cargo e confirma. Na disputa presidencial, os nulos representavam 2,93% dos votos registrados.

O índice de abstenção no estado de São Paulo atingiu 22,56% dos eleitores aptos a votar neste domingo (4), o que equivale à ausência de 7.687.443 de eleitores.

Segundo dados do TRE-SP, é a maior abstenção em primeiros turnos de eleições para governador desde pelo menos 2014.

O indicador tem aumentado a cada pleito:

Em 2022, foram 21,61% (7.495.213 de eleitores)

Em 2018, 21,52% (7.111.896 de eleitores)

Em 2014, 19,52% (6.245.198 de eleitores)

A ausência de eleitores em todo o país foi de 21,08%, a maior registrada em um primeiro turno de eleição presidencial desde 1998, quando 21,49% dos eleitores não compareceram às urnas.

O índice nacional também vem aumentando a cada disputa desde 2006: passou de 16,75% naquele ano para 18,12% em 2010, 19,39% em 2014, 20,33% em 2018 e 20,95% em 2022. O percentual de 2026 ainda pode mudar com a conclusão da apuração.

articles.title: Da periferia aos bairros nobres, veja a comemoração de eleitores após vitória de Lula em SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Registros em Paraisópolis, Pinheiros e Higienópolis mostram festas após Lula (PT) derrotar Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e conquistar um inédito quarto mandato na Presidência do Brasil.
articles.summary: Registros em Paraisópolis, Pinheiros e Higienópolis mostram festas após Lula (PT) derrotar Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e conquistar um inédito quarto mandato na Presidência do Brasil.
articles.body:
A vitória de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sobre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) na eleição presidencial deste domingo (25) foi celebrada por eleitores em diferentes regiões da cidade de São Paulo.

De Paraisópolis, na Zona Sul, a bairros como Pinheiros e Higienópolis, na região central e na Zona Oeste da capital, vídeos registraram manifestações de apoiadores do petista após a confirmação do resultado das urnas.

Lula foi reeleito presidente da República e conquistou o inédito quarto mandato à frente do Palácio do Planalto. O petista venceu uma disputa acirrada depois de ficar atrás de Flávio Bolsonaro no primeiro turno.

A confirmação da vitória ocorreu às 21h08, quando 97% das urnas já haviam sido apuradas . Naquele momento, Lula tinha 51,74% dos votos válidos, contra 48,26% do adversário.

A vitória de Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) sobre Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) na eleição presidencial deste domingo (25) foi celebrada por eleitores em diferentes regiões da cidade de São Paulo. — Foto: Reprodução

Aos 80 anos, às vésperas de completar 81 na terça-feira (27), Lula se tornou o primeiro presidente da história do Brasil a ser eleito quatro vezes pelo voto popular.

Em Paraisópolis, moradores se reuniram nas ruas, empunhados de bandeiras com símbolos do PT. Alguns deles com motocicletas e carros celebravam a vitória do petista.

Já em Pinheiros e Higienópolis, foi possível escutar moradores gritando nas janelas dos apartamentos após o anúncio da vitória de Lula.

Na capital paulista, Lula venceu com 55,50%, ou 3.864.354 dos votos válidos, após 100% das urnas apuradas, contra 44,50% de Flávio Bolsonaro, que teve 3.097.923 votos válidos.

O resultado marca mais um capítulo da trajetória política do petista, que chegou à Presidência pela primeira vez em 2003, foi reeleito em 2006 e voltou ao cargo em 2023, após derrotar Jair Bolsonaro, pai de Flávio, na eleição de 2022.

A nova vitória garante a Lula mais quatro anos no comando do Executivo federal.

Lula e a 2ª esposa, Marisa Letícia, com os filhos Fábio Luiz, Sandro Luiz e Luiz Cláudio. — Foto: Instituto Lula

Lula nasceu em 27 de outubro de 1945, em Garanhuns, no interior de Pernambuco. É o sétimo dos oito filhos do casal de lavradores Aristides Inácio da Silva e Eurídice Ferreira de Mello, conhecida como Dona Lindu.

O pai deixou Pernambuco quando Lula ainda era bebê e se mudou para o litoral paulista em busca de trabalho. Em dezembro de 1952, aos sete anos, Lula viajou com a mãe e os irmãos para São Paulo, em um caminhão pau de arara..

A família se instalou inicialmente no Guarujá, onde reencontrou Aristides, que já havia formado outra família e a dona Lindu acabou se separando do marido.

Em 1956, mãe e filhos se mudaram para a capital paulista, onde passaram a morar em um pequeno cômodo nos fundos de um bar.

Lula foi vendedor ambulante, engraxate e office boy, até conseguir emprego na Fábrica de Parafusos Marte.

Aos 14 anos, ingressou na indústria e aos 18 anos concluiu o curso de torneiro mecânico pelo Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial (Senai). Antes disso, aos 17 anos, perdeu o dedo mínimo da mão esquerda em um acidente de trabalho.

A vida pessoal de Lula também foi marcada por perdas familiares. Em 1969, casou-se com a operária Maria de Lourdes da Silva, que morreu gravida em 1971.

Em 1974, Lula se casou com Marisa Letícia, com quem viveu por mais de quatro décadas.

Lula e dona Marisa tiveram três filhos, Fábio Luís, Sandro Luís e Luís Cláudio. Lula também é pai de Marcos Cláudio, filho de Marisa de um relacionamento anterior, que foi adotado pelo petista, e de Lurian, fruto de outro relacionamento com Miriam Cordeiro

Marisa acompanhou a ascensão política de Lula, desde o movimento sindical até a Presidência da República. Ela morreu em fevereiro de 2017, aos 66 anos, após sofrer um acidente vascular cerebral (AVC).

Em maio de 2022, Lula se casou pela terceira vez, com a socióloga Rosângela da Silva, conhecida como Janja. A cerimônia ocorreu em São Paulo, durante a campanha que levaria o petista de volta à Presidência da República.

articles.title: Back to the classroom: Nearly 7 lakh elders take literacy test across Maharashtra
articles.summary: Nearly 7 lakh elderly learners in Maharashtra took the ULLAS FLNAT literacy and numeracy test, marking a major push for adult education and life skills.
articles.body: CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR/KOLHAPUR/NASHIK: A grandson taught his grandmother her first letters. Another proudly accompanied his grandfather to an exam. On Sunday, together, they turned a literacy test into a celebration of second chances.65-year-old Mangal Baban Mane of Kolhapur once dreamt of becoming a govt officer. Life had other plans. Poverty and circumstances cut short her education.On Sunday, decades later, she took her seat for Foundational Literacy and Numeracy Assessment Test (FLNAT), carrying with her lessons taught not by a teacher, but by her grandson.“My grandson is in Class V. He taught me Marathi letters and helped me learn words. He also taught me counting from one to 100,” Mane said. “Now I can do basic addition and subtraction. Most importantly, I can write my own name.”Hundreds of kilometres away in Nashik, science graduate Shashank Borse proudly escorted his 68-year-old grandfather to another examination centre.The older man had spent his life in the fields so that future generations could study. On Sunday, it was his turn to become the student.Together, their stories captured the spirit of a remarkable statewide exercise that saw nearly seven lakh elderly learners appear for FLNAT under the ULLAS (Understanding of Lifelong Learning for All in Society) programme of New India Literacy Programme (NILP).For Vimal Kanu, 60, from Satara’s Man taluka, the examination marked another milestone in a journey of self-belief. She had appeared last year but did not clear the test. This time, she walked into the classroom with confidence.“The change in my life is visible,” she said. “Earlier, I used a thumb impression. Now I sign my name. I can read small words and understand what is written. I can even check whether a shopkeeper has returned the correct balance,” she added.Across Maharashtra, elderly men and women who had missed out on schooling decades ago returned to classrooms, many writing their first formal examination.For many elders, achievement was just writing testThe test, conducted in nine languages, including Marathi, Hindi, English and Urdu, is part of govt’s effort to bring non-literate adults into the education system.“Around seven lakh learners registered on the ULLAS app appeared for the examination. Those who qualify can continue their education through standards three, five, eight, 10 and 12 equivalents,” said education director (planning) Krishnakumar Patil.“He spent his youth working on the farm so the generations after him could study,” Borse said of his grandfather.“Because of his sacrifices, my father became a teacher and I found a job in Nashik. Taking him to this exam was one of the proudest moments of our lives. He is the only one among seven siblings who dared to take the test. I hope others now follow him,” Borse said.The response was especially strong in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, where more than 41,000 candidates appeared at 2,698 centres. Against a target of 47,368 learners, 43,700 had registered for the programme.Officials said the initiative extends beyond literacy.“Through FLNAT, we aim to build financial, legal and digital literacy, along with health awareness and other life skills that help improve quality of life,” Patil said.The scale of the literacy drive came alive at the Dhoregaon cluster, where 198 neo-literates turned up to write the test at Zilla Parishad Central Primary School and its satellite centres.Guided by centre head Sachin Damale, in-charge headmaster Rajesh Hiwale and a team of teachers, the centres transformed into classrooms of second chances as elderly learners, many writing an examination for the first time in their lives, took their seats with quiet determination.“They were welcomed with flowers before the exam,” said Hiwale. “The welcome eased their fears and boosted their confidence. The most memorable sight was seeing elderly learners arrive with their grandchildren, who watched with pride as their grandparents read, wrote and solved questions on their own.”The examination carried 150 marks and required a minimum score of 33%.For many candidates, however, the day’s biggest achievement was not the result that will arrive later. It was simply walking into a classroom, taking a seat and writing the test.Stay updated with the latest Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar news. Download the TOI App.

articles.standfirst: Região terá céu nublado e possibilidade de chuva isolada até quarta-feira (28). A partir de quinta (29), previsão indica pancadas de chuva e trovoadas.
articles.summary: Região terá céu nublado e possibilidade de chuva isolada até quarta-feira (28). A partir de quinta (29), previsão indica pancadas de chuva e trovoadas.
articles.body:
A semana será marcada por muita nebulosidade em Juiz de Fora — Foto: Juliana Netto/g1

A semana será marcada por muita nebulosidade, temperaturas amenas e possibilidade de chuva na Zona da Mata mineira. Segundo o climatologista, Lizandro Gimiacki, a passagem de uma frente fria e a atuação de uma área de alta pressão sobre o oceano favorecem o transporte de umidade para a região.

Até quarta-feira (28), a previsão é de céu parcialmente nublado a nublado, com possibilidade de chuvas isoladas. Já a partir de quinta-feira (29), a expectativa é de retorno das pancadas de chuva acompanhadas de trovoadas.

Em Juiz de Fora , as temperaturas devem variar entre 17°C e 20°C nesta segunda-feira (26). Na terça-feira (27), os termômetros ficam entre 13°C e 21°C. Na quarta (28), a mínima permanece em 14°C, e a máxima chega a 20°C.

Na quinta-feira (29), as temperaturas variam entre 16°C e 21°C. Já na sexta-feira (30), os termômetros ficam entre 17°C e 23°C.

Nas demais cidades da Zona da Mata, as temperaturas devem variar entre 16°C e 25°C nesta segunda-feira. Na terça, a previsão é de mínima de 12°C e máxima de 26°C. Na quarta-feira, os termômetros ficam entre 13°C e 25°C.

Na quinta-feira, as temperaturas variam entre 15°C e 26°C. Na sexta, a máxima pode chegar a 28°C, com mínima de 16°C.

Apesar de alguns períodos de abertura de sol, principalmente na terça-feira, a umidade e a nebulosidade devem predominar ao longo da semana, mantendo as temperaturas sem grandes elevações na região.

articles.title: Torneira de banheiro: mesa, parede ou bica alta? | G1
articles.standfirst: Cuba, bancada e altura da bica definem qual modelo funciona melhor no dia a dia do banheiro.
articles.summary: Cuba, bancada e altura da bica definem qual modelo funciona melhor no dia a dia do banheiro.
articles.body:
Instalada diretamente na bancada ou na cuba, a torneira de mesa é a opção mais usada em banheiros e lavabos. Ela pode ter bica baixa, mais comum em cubas embutidas, ou bica alta, indicada para cubas de apoio.

Como a cuba de apoio fica acima do tampo, a torneira precisa ser alta o bastante para permitir lavar as mãos com conforto. Por outro lado, uma bica muito alta numa cuba rasa pode gerar respingos. Vale conferir a altura da bica em relação ao fundo da cuba antes de comprar.

Na versão de parede, o ponto de água é embutido, o que deixa a bancada livre e facilita a limpeza. Em contrapartida, exige planejamento: a posição precisa ser definida antes de revestir a parede, e o jato deve cair no centro da cuba. A Docol tem torneiras de mesa e de parede, além de misturadores, entre os metais disponíveis na Panorama.

Cromado, preto fosco e tons escovados estão entre as opções. Manter o mesmo acabamento entre torneira, chuveiro e acessórios ajuda a dar unidade ao ambiente.

Anotar as medidas da cuba, a altura da bancada e a posição do ponto de água facilita a escolha do modelo correto e evita trocas depois da instalação.

articles.title: Haddad diz que vitória de Lula garante soberania do país no cenário internacional: 'Brasil não tem tamanho pra ser quintal de ninguém'  | G1
articles.standfirst: O candidato derrotado ao governo paulista atribuiu a vitória de virada do petista à mobilização da sociedade em torno do apreço à Constituição.
articles.summary: O candidato derrotado ao governo paulista atribuiu a vitória de virada do petista à mobilização da sociedade em torno do apreço à Constituição.
articles.body:
O ex-prefeito de SP Fernando Haddad (PT) em hotel em SP — Foto: Rodrigo Rodrigues/g1

O ex-ministro da Fazenda, Fernando Haddad (PT), disse neste domingo (25) que a eleição do presidente Lula (PT) para seu quarto mandato significa a garantia da soberania do país no cenário internacional.

“Não tem paralelo o que aconteceu no Brasil. O país era uma peça-chave no tabuleiro internacional. E o Lula conseguiu garantir as duas coisas mais importantes: soberania popular e nacional. A soberania interna e uma diplomacia responsável. Porque o Brasil não tem tamanho para ser quintal de ninguém”, declarou.

O candidato derrotado ao governo paulista atribuiu a vitória de virada do petista à mobilização da sociedade em torno do apreço à Constituição Brasileira e soberania do país.

“Acho que foi histórico o que aconteceu nos últimos 15 dias no Brasil. A maneira como a população reagiu. Todo mundo saiu da passividade, do conformismo e foi exercer a cidadania. Milhões de pessoas na rua para manifestar seu apreço à Constituição, pela soberania do país. O fim da fome, o fim do desmatamento”, afirmou.

Apesar da euforia dos petistas com a vitória de Lula pela quarta vez, Haddad afirmou que o novo governo Lula precisará dialogar com o lado derrotado.

“O governo que foi reeleito também precisa dialogar com o outro lado. É uma realidade que exige diálogo. Tem que conversar mais, falar mais. Não podemos mais passar esse susto de novo”, disse.

“O Lula é um homem muito experiente. O mundo está passando por uma situação difícil. E passa por um momento delicado. Por isso acho que o povo brasileiro optou por ele”, completou.

Sobre a relação difícil com o Congresso eleito, com muitos senadores do PL, Haddad afirmou que Lula tem experiência para lidar com esse cenário.

“Falaram o mesmo do Congresso passado [que era conservador] e nós aprovamos todas as medidas e reformas”, declarou.

O deputado federal André Janones abraça o presidente Lula, reeleito neste domingo — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

Ao chegar ao Hotel Intercontinental para comemorar a reeleição do petista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva neste domingo (25), Janones afirmou que conseguiu criar o canal de Whatsapp "Exército do Lula", com mais de 10 milhões de seguidores, graças à missão de defender a democracia.

“Eu agradeço [o título de maior nome do 2º turno], mas o nome real desta eleição é Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. A energia vem dele, a força vem dele. Eu recebi a missão de canalizar isso. A energia nunca emanou de mim. Eu peguei a energia dele e, como se fosse um cano, canalizei essa energia para distribuir para o povo brasileiro”, afirmou.

“A gente reagiu à covardia. E mostrou que, da mesma forma que eles se reúnem para fazer o mal e assassinar reputações, a gente mostrou que é possível se unir para defender a democracia”, declarou.

Janones voltou a comparar Lula com o jogador Leonel Messi, da Seleção Argentina, e disse que ele não precisa usar as redes sociais e tem uma juventude inteira ‘para correr por ele’.

“Nós jogamos para o Messi. O Messi nunca deixou de ser gênio. Ele fala na seleção da Argentina: olha, eu não consigo correr mais, mas o restante eu faço. Os jovens disseram: eu corro por você. Eu dizia para o Lula: ‘O senhor não tem que aprender a usar rede social. O senhor já fez o que tinha que fazer. Nas redes sociais, nós correremos pelo senhor’. E foi isso que a gente fez”, declarou.

Janones após vitória de Lula — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

Sofre o fato de ganhar algum cargo no futuro governo Lula, Janones afirma que nunca teve esse tipo de conversa sobre cargos com o presidente reeleito e o PT e não almeja, por ora, esse agrado, como recompensa pelo trabalho no segundo turno.

“Nunca houve essa conversa. Em 2022, as pessoas diziam que o presidente Lula deveria ter me nomeado ministro. Ele não deveria porque uma condição [minha] em 2022 era que eu continuasse na Câmara dos Deputados. O meu compromisso é com a democracia e com o maior presidente que este país já teve”, afirmou.

Lula faz discurso da vitória em hotel na capital paulista — Foto: Rafael Peixoto/g1

'Nós enfrentamos todos', diz marqueteiro

Principal nome do marketing da campanha vitoriosa de Lula (PT), o marqueteiro Sidônio Palmeira, ex-ministro-chefe da Secretaria de Comunicação Social do Brasil, comemorou neste domingo (25) a vitória do petista de virada no segundo turno.

“Acho que a gente voltou para esse segundo turno e pautou falando dos projetos do governo e discutindo o futuro do país. Nós enfrentamos todos: Trump, o tarifaço, os Bolsonaro querendo entregar o país. Tudo isso, e o provo compreendeu o que estava em jogo e deu a vitória ao presidente Lula”, afirmou ao g1 .

Muitas vezes questionado dentro e fora do PT sobre as estratégias de campanha do primeiro turno, que levaram Lula a chegar atrás de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Sidônio afirmou que não se sentiu pressionado após a derrota na primeira etapa e se disse convicto sobre a sugestão de proibição das bets no Brasil.

“Para ser sincero, eu não fui pressionado em nenhum momento. Eu sugeri ao presidente proibir as bets. E ele aceitou com a maior naturalidade. Não senti nenhuma pressão. A minha relação com o presidente é a mesma desde o primeiro turno e durante o período. Nós estivemos sempre do lado do povo brasileiro”, afirmou.

O marqueteiro da campanha de Lula, Sidônio Palmeira (PT) fala sobre a reeleição do presidente — Foto: Rodrigo Rodrigues/g1

articles.title: Corpo de menino que se afogou no rio Candeias é encontrado | G1
articles.standfirst: Buscas começaram no sábado (24) com apoio de embarcações e drone. Forte correnteza e a baixa visibilidade dificultaram as operações de resgate.
articles.summary: Menino desaparecido no Rio Candeias: Bombeiros retomam buscas nesta segunda-feira com apoio de drones e embarcações após suspensão por falta de luz.
articles.body:
Foi encontrado o corpo do menino de 12 anos que desapareceu após se afogar no Rio Candeias, em Candeias do Jamari (RO), no sábado (24). A informação foi confirmada pelo Corpo de Bombeiros e pela família da vítima nesta segunda-feira (26).

As buscas especializadas começaram nas primeiras horas da manhã de domingo (25), com equipes de mergulho e salvamento do Grupamento de Busca e Salvamento (GBS). Os trabalhos incluíram varreduras e mergulhos no ponto indicado por uma testemunha que presenciou o ocorrido.

Além dos bombeiros, participaram das buscas os familiares e amigos da família. De acordo com a corporação, a forte correnteza e a baixa visibilidade dificultaram as operações. Por volta das 18h de domingo, as buscas subaquáticas foram temporariamente suspensas devido à falta de luz natural e aos riscos operacionais.

Ainda segundo os Bombeiros, os trabalhos seriam retomados no início da manhã desta segunda-feira (26), com o reforço de uma equipe de busca fluvial, embarcações e o uso de um drone para ampliar a área de varredura ao longo do rio e das margens.

articles.title: Obama unloads on Trump while stumping for Democrats ahead of midterms
articles.summary: US president Trump has been telling voters to view the midterm elections as if he were on the ballot, and on Saturday one of his Democratic predecessors
articles.body: US president Trump has been telling voters to view the midterm elections as if he were on the ballot, and on Saturday one of his Democratic predecessors did just that. Days away from the elections that will determine control of the closely divided Congress, Barack Obama took to the campaign trail to accuse the Republican president of corruption, deride his strategy for Iran and skewer the gilded aesthetic he has applied to White House renovations.Obama stumped for Democratic candidates at rallies in Cleveland and Detroit, lampooning the Trump administration. Campaigning in Michigan for US Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, Obama framed the Nov 3 vote as a "circuit breaker" to "at least rein in some of the foolishness" of Trump's presidency. "We got to bring some accountability to this govt," Obama said.Obama, president from 2009 until Trump began his first term in 2017, remains one of the most popular figures among Democrats. They hope that bringing him into the race can fire up their supporters for a tight US Senate race in which El-Sayed faces Republican Mike Rogers, a former US representative.The former president obliged the Michigan crowd by playing to Democrats' frequently repeated criticisms of Trump and of Republicans' willingness to go along with him. "We have never seen a president excel in straight-up grifting, on your dime, like this," Obama said. "Never seen a president so intent on selling favours like this ... Now the party seems to stand for corrupt govt, or inept govt, or no govt."The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. But in a Truth Social post on early Sunday, Trump called Obama a "grossly incompetent President" and labelled El-Sayed a "Muslim Brotherhood Jihadist, who hates Jews and Blacks and AMERICANS and TRUMP".Obama also ridiculed the administration's claims of victory against Iran. He argued that the war has given Iran more economic leverage because its threats to attack shipping in the Strait of Hormuz have unsettled oil exporters.In his social media post, Trump derided the Obama administration's approach to the Iranians, saying that he "paid off Iran with $Billions, and gave them a road to a Nuclear Weapon" with his 2015 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action accord with Iran. US withdrew from the 2015 agreement during Trump's first term.He also accused Trump administration of emphasising unimportant matters, sarcastically calling defence secretary Pete Hegseth someone "laser-focused on important matters like the jawline and testosterone levels of troops" and ridiculing White House renovations as tacky. articles.title: Delhi’s Shangri-La Eros hotel fined Rs 1L for automatically adding 10% service charge to food bills, CCPA orders restaurant to stop collecting it by default after finding customers were also charged GST on added amount despite hotel claiming charge was 'optional'
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of Rs 1 lakh on Delhi's Shangri-La Eros hotel for illegally levying a 10%
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a penalty of Rs 1 lakh on Delhi's Shangri-La Eros hotel for illegally levying a 10% service charge on food bills at its "Mister Chai" restaurant. It has also directed the restaurant to "discontinue and refrain from collecting any charge automatically or by default or under any other name".The order, passed last week, noted that the hotel had submitted to the authority in late September that it was discontinuing the practice from Oct 1.The order, passed by CCPA chief commissioner Nidhi Khare and commissioner Anupam Mishra, detailed how the restaurant had automatically added service charge to bills - Rs 435 on a subtotal of Rs 4,350 and Rs 125 on a subtotal of Rs 1,250 - and subsequently levied GST on the inflated amounts. A consumer had complained that a 10% service charge was forcibly levied on food bills and submitted invoices as evidence.Following the complaint, CCPA issued a notice to the hotel. In its response, the hotel argued that service charge was discretionary and that the option to request a waiver was explicitly mentioned on every page of the menu. It denied forcing customers to pay the charge, claiming that the complainant had not raised any objection before or after paying the bills. The hotel had termed it as "Charges for Voluntary Service Staff Contribution (optional)".Rejecting the hotel's defence, CCPA said placing the "onus on consumers to opt out of an automatically levied service charge contradicts" its guidelines, which have been upheld by the Delhi High Court."The restaurant's defence that the customer 'had enough time to deny payment' itself confirms that their billing software/POS system automatically includes the 10% service charge, thereby impacting a wider class of consumers as envisaged under Section 10 of Consumer Protection Act," the authority said.It held that the practice amounted to an unfair trade practice. articles.title: Riyadh airport partially reopens: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi ballistic missile, drones
articles.summary: Saudi-led coalition on early Monday claimed it intercepted a ballistic missile launched towards Riyadh by the Houthis as the rebel group continues to
articles.body: Saudi-led coalition on early Monday claimed it intercepted a ballistic missile launched towards Riyadh by the Houthis as the rebel group continues to target the partially open King Khalid International Airport.On Sunday, the Houthi group said it had launched dozens of ballistic missiles in three attacks against the kingdom, the first of which targeted King Khalid International Airport and "successfully achieved its objective."Other attacks targeted King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait and a Saudi Border Guard naval base in Jazan.Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree renewed a warning to airlines, employees and travellers against using King Khalid International Airport, describing it as "unsafe."“The Yemeni Armed Forces renew their warning to all global, regional, and local airlines, as well as employees and travellers, against travelling through Khalid Airport in Riyadh, as it is unsafe, being a military target for our forces,” Saree said on X.The airport administration previously announced that Terminal 1 would handle domestic flights and Terminal 2 international flights operated by national carriers, effective Sunday.Saree also issued a broader warning against using Saudi airspace while excluding the airspace over Mecca and Medina.Separately, the Houthi-controlled Saba news agency quoted a military source as warning workers and civilians "not to approach Saudi oil facilities," while cautioning Saudi Aramco shareholders of "losses" if they continued to hold shares in the company.The Saudi-led coalition on Sunday said it had intercepted and destroyed a total of 12 missiles and two drones launched toward the kingdom, including a ballistic missile and two drones targeting the Riyadh region. Xinua reported.Saree also claimed that Saudi warplanes had carried out 56 airstrikes and missile attacks against civilian assets across seven Yemeni provinces in the past 24 hours. In a post on X, he said the attacks targeted Hodeidah, Lahj, Amran, Saada, Al-Jawf, Taiz and Ibb, involving F-15 and Typhoon aircraft operating from Khamis Mushait and Taif airbases, as well as missile attacks from Najran.Saree claimed the total number of Saudi airstrikes and missile attacks since the escalation against Yemen had reached 3,179. articles.title: Actress Urmila Sanawar arrested over Rs 5 crore extortion from ex-BJP MLA’s daughter, days after ‘VIP’ audio tapes in Rishikesh murder case surface
articles.summary: HARIDWAR: Haridwar police arrested actress Urmila Sanawar from Saharanpur after former BJP MLA Suresh Rathore's daughter accused her of demanding Rs 5
articles.body: HARIDWAR: Haridwar police arrested actress Urmila Sanawar from Saharanpur after former BJP MLA Suresh Rathore's daughter accused her of demanding Rs 5 crore and the transfer of Ravidas Dham property, besides threatening to kill her family.Police registered an FIR at Ranipur police station on Sunday on charges of extortion and criminal intimidation, along with allegations concerning objectionable social media remarks.The arrest came amid a separate CBI investigation into audio recordings released by Sanawar that allegedly identified a politically connected 'VIP' in the 2022 Rishikesh resort murder case.The complainant, daughter of the former Jwalapur MLA, alleged that Sanawar called her on Saturday night and demanded Rs 5 crore and the transfer of Ravidas Dham property to her name.She also allegedly threatened to kill her family members and implicate Rathore in false cases if her demands were not met.The complainant further alleged that Sanawar made derogatory remarks about her father on social media, accused him of having illicit relationships with a woman from Dehradun and others, and threatened to beat him with slippers.Actress faced earlier complaint over objectionable photos, videosPolice subsequently traced Sanawar to Saharanpur and arrested her. Haridwar SSP Navneet Singh Bhullar told TOI, "A case has been registered against Urmila Sanawar on the basis of a complaint filed by Suresh Rathore's daughter on Sunday, and she was subsequently arrested by the police. She is being produced before the court."Police records reportedly indicated that nine cases had been registered against Sanawar in Saharanpur, Dehradun, Ranipur and Haridwar.The latest complaint followed another case Rathore's daughter filed last year, alleging that Sanawar and a man had circulated objectionable photographs and videos of her on social media.Police arrested the male accused in that case and subsequently filed a chargesheet in court.Arrest followed Sanawar and Rathore's appearance before a special CBI court in Dehradun on October 23, when both gave their consent to proposed narcoanalysis tests in connection with 2022 Rishikesh resort murder case.Court was scheduled to take up the matter again on October 26. The victim's parents had earlier approached CBI seeking tests to establish the authenticity of audio recordings and examine allegations concerning an unidentified 'VIP'.Sanawar had released recordings that she claimed contained conversations with Rathore and references to a senior political figure allegedly connected with the murder.Allegations named Dushyant Kumar Gautam, a senior BJP leader recently appointed governor of Sikkim, as the purported 'VIP'. Gautam denied the allegations.In the original murder case, a court sentenced resort owner Pulkit Arya, son of former BJP leader Vinod Arya, and two accomplices to life imprisonment.Fresh CBI inquiry concerned allegations arising from the audio recordings and remained separate from the extortion case registered against Sanawar.Stay updated with the latest Dehradun news. articles.title: ‘Physically impossible’: Ukraine hits back at Musk over Starlink restrictions, disputes offensive drone strike claim
articles.summary: A Ukrainian defence technology adviser has challenged Elon Musk’s claim that Ukraine’s military breached Starlink’s terms of service by using the
articles.body: A Ukrainian defence technology adviser has challenged Elon Musk’s claim that Ukraine’s military breached Starlink’s terms of service by using the satellite network for offensive drone strikes, prompting SpaceX to restrict access to the high-speed technology.According to CNBC news report, Serhii Beskrestnov, an adviser to Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy on defence technology, disputed Musk’s explanation in a telegram post on Sunday. He argued that existing operational restrictions on Starlink in Ukraine would have made the type of attacks described by the SpaceX chief technically impossible.Ukrainian officials have previously said the restrictions disrupted military drone operations and weakened the country’s ability to defend itself against Russian attacks.Musk alleged on Saturday that Ukraine’s military had violated Starlink’s terms of service by using the network for offensive drone strikes intended to kill people. He made the claim in a post on X.Beskrestnov questioned Musk’s understanding of how the system operates in Ukraine, pointing out that Starlink’s civilian service does not work inside Russian territory. He also said Ukrainian drones using the technology had been subject to speed limits of 70 to 90 kmph (43 to 56 mph) for several months.“Consequently, it is physically impossible for us to use commercial Starlink for deep-strike or medium-range strike operations,” Beskrestnov wrote.Starlink and Starshield services restoredUkrainian officials said on Saturday that high-speed connectivity through spacex’s starlink and starshield satellite communication systems had been restored. Kyiv had blamed the service disruption for affecting its drone-based air defence capabilities amid repeated Russian aerial attacks.Starlink is spacex’s commercial satellite internet network, while Starshield is a military-oriented system designed for government and national security applications using technology developed for Starlink.Before Musk publicly acknowledged restricting the systems, uncertainty surrounded the decision and who had ordered the changes. Musk had earlier suggested in a social media post that the US government was responsible, but US president Donald Trump said he was unaware of the decision.Ukrainian officials have also said the restrictions were imposed by Starlink or the US without advance warning, catching the country off guard. Musk has not publicly explained why Ukraine was reportedly not notified before the changes took effect.Musk and SpaceX did not respond to CNBC’s requests for comment.Ukraine and allies explore alternativesThe disruption has added urgency to efforts by Ukraine and its partners to develop or secure alternative satellite communication networks that would reduce their dependence on foreign providers.Poland’s deputy defence minister Cezary Tomczyk discussed his country’s plans in an episode of the podcast influence zone earlier this month. Ukraine has also announced partnerships involving Norway, finland’s telecommunications company nokia and satellite manufacturer ICEYE as part of efforts to develop alternatives.Other countries are pursuing similar initiatives. The European union is developing IRIS², a satellite constellation intended to strengthen the bloc’s communications infrastructure and strategic autonomy. However, its first launches are not expected until 2029.Starlink revenue rises amid growing demandSpaceX’s Starlink business generated $5.25 billion in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, up from $3.1 billion in the corresponding period a year earlier.Consumer subscriptions accounted for $3.12 billion of the quarterly revenue, while government and enterprise customers contributed $2.13 billion.A range of customers, including non-government organisations, the governments of Poland and France, and the US Pentagon, have paid spacex to supply starlink and Starshield equipment and connectivity services for use in Ukraine.You use AI every day. articles.title: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky to everyone: You will not survive AI layoffs if you are one of these
articles.summary: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said that the biggest risk to professionals in the AI era is not the technology itself, but the refusal to evolve.
articles.body: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said that the biggest risk to professionals in the AI era is not the technology itself, but the refusal to evolve. Speaking on the Invest Like The Best podcast, Brian Chesky said “The two types of people who will not make the shift to AI are pure people managers, and people that are rigid and don’t want to change and evolve,”. Explaining that as AI transforms company structures and how employees do their jobs, managers need to adapt to the new era. During the podcast, he specifically called out people managers saying that every higher-up will have to be a “hybrid people manager” or “manager IC” (individual contributor) to succeed.“I don’t think people managers will have any value in the future. When I mean people managers, [I mean] people that only manage people,” Chesky continued. “You can’t just be these managers where you’re people’s therapists, and you’re just doing meetings, you’re doing one-on-ones.”Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky quoted former Apple chief design officer Jony IveDuring the conversation, Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky quoted former Apple chief design officer Jony Ive as an example saying that he struck the right balance between product design and team leadership. Brian Chesky said managers should build strong relationships with their employees through regular check-ins and activities such as having dinner with their team members. However, he added that simply supervising employees is no longer enough. Managers now need to guide employees through their work and help them perform better.Chesky also warned that employees who avoid learning new technology may struggle in the AI era. However, he said learning to use these tools is not difficult if people have a “growth mindset” and are willing to learn. His views echo those of several tech leaders who say AI may not necessarily replace workers, but people who know how to use AI tools could have an advantage over those who do not.You use AI every day. articles.body: FIROZABAD: Four people, including women and children, were killed and several others injured after a speeding car rammed into a group of villagers on their way to immerse Tesu-Jhenjhi idols in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad district.Firozabad district magistrate Santosh Kumar Sharma stated that the vehicle involved has been seized, and the driver, along with the other occupants, has been taken into custody."A road accident has occurred involving a car, resulting in four deaths and eight injuries. The victims were walking along the roadside in a group that included many women and children from a village when the accident took place. Arrangements are being made to ensure proper medical treatment for those injured. The vehicle involved has been seized, and the driver, along with the other occupants, has been taken into custody, " Santosh Kumar told news agency ANI."A thorough investigation into the causes of the incident will be conducted. Furthermore, we are reaching out to the Chief Minister's Office to request financial assistance for the families of the deceased. Regarding the cause, while it is a matter for investigation, preliminary reports suggest that the driver may have been under the influence of alcohol; the full picture will emerge once the investigation is complete. Most importantly, this is a deeply tragic incident, " Santosh Kumar added.The district administration is arranging specialised medical treatment for the injured and has approached the Chief Minister’s Office to seek financial assistance for the families of the deceased."The entire administration and the government stand with the bereaved families, and we are committed to providing all possible support, including medical care for the injured and other necessary follow-up actions," district magistrate Santosh Kumar Sharma said.Tesu-Jhenjhi is a traditional folk festival celebrated in parts of Uttar Pradesh like Agra, Mathura, Kanpur, Etawah, Orai, and Jhansi. articles.title: Jordan arrests 3 suspects in church attack that killed 9, wounded 40
articles.summary: Three people were arrested in Jordan on Monday in connection with Friday's church attack in the Karak governorate that killed nine people and wounded 40
articles.body: Three people were arrested in Jordan on Monday in connection with Friday's church attack in the Karak governorate that killed nine people and wounded 40 others.Jordan's Public Security Directorate said security forces tracked down the suspects early Monday while they were hiding in an abandoned house. The suspects refused to surrender and opened fire on the forces, who returned fire and arrested all three after they were wounded.No security personnel were injured in the operation, and firearms and ammunition were seized, the directorate said.The statement did not identify the suspects or specify whether they were affiliated with any militant group.Jordan's interior minister said on Friday that extremists were behind the attack, but added that it was too early to establish whether they had links to known groups inside or outside the country. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.The attack drew condemnation from across the region, including Lebanon, Syria, Egypt and Oman. Ahmed al-Tayeb, the grand imam of Cairo's Al-Azhar, offered condolences to the victims' families and described the shooting as a “heinous terrorist attack”.Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein also spoke to his Jordanian counterpart, expressing Baghdad's support for Amman. Hussein's office said he “affirmed Iraq’s solidarity with Jordan in the face of terrorism”.United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres condemned the attack, describing violence during a funeral as “especially heinous”, his spokesman Stephane Dujarric said. “The secretary-general also calls for all those responsible to be found and to be held to account,” Dujarric added.India also strongly condemned the attack. The Ministry of external affairs denounced the killings and expressed solidarity with Jordan, while EAM S Jaishankar offered condolences to the victims' families and wished those injured a speedy recovery.You use AI every day. articles.title: In 1987, Beyonce's family bought a 1935 Houston home where she spent her school years; after extensive renovations through 2026, the 4,010-square-foot property was listed for $1.275 million and sold in May 2026
articles.summary: A house in Houston where Beyonce spent seven years of her childhood has attracted multiple offers after being put on the market for $1.275 million in
articles.body: A house in Houston where Beyonce spent seven years of her childhood has attracted multiple offers after being put on the market for $1.275 million in April. The property, which her family purchased in 1987, has changed considerably since Beyonce lived there, long before she became one of the world's best-known singers.The 4,010-square-foot property stands at 3346 Parkwood Drive in Houston's Riverside Terrace neighbourhood. According to property details listed by the Houston Association of Realtors (HAR), the house was built in 1935 and has four bedrooms, three-and-a-half bathrooms, a renovated kitchen, a swimming pool, a large walk-in wardrobe and a separate garage apartment. The Houston Chronicle reported that the house received several offers within approximately two weeks of being listed. By April 22, a local buyer had entered into a contract to purchase it.The house was part of Beyonce's life between the ages of around six and 13. Her family lived there from 1987 until 1994, a period when she was beginning to develop her skills as a performer. It was here that she became involved with Girls Tyme, the group that came before Destiny's Child.Although the Knowles family moved out more than three decades ago, the property is still cherished by Beyonce's fans. People regularly stop outside to take photographs, and tour buses visit the street.What Beyonce's childhood home looks likeThe property has undergone several renovations since the Knowles family lived there. Much of the work carried out between 2018 and 2026 focused on updating the interiors while keeping some features from the original 1935 construction.The kitchen was completely redesigned and now has a large marble island and Wolf appliances. Upstairs, the main bedroom suite includes an upgraded bathroom with quartz countertops and modern fittings. The suite was also expanded at some point, while an adjoining room was converted into a large walk-in wardrobe with white shelves and a crystal-like chandelier.Previous owners also added a swimming pool, an outdoor summer kitchen and a 600-square-foot garage apartment. The property also has a three-car garage, which opens onto an alley behind the house.Some of the older details remain visible, including decorative ironwork that covers the double entrance doors, while the interior retains its original hardwood flooring and curved staircase. Outside, a circular driveway leads towards the house, with a lawn at the front.Beyonce's mother on the family homeFor Beyonce's mother, Tina Knowles, the property was a place where the family could spend time together. In her 2025 memoir Matriarch, she recalled buying the house after the family had previously lived on Rosedale Street in Houston.She described the Parkwood Drive property as the “perfect, white-brick dream house”. One reason she liked it was that it offered enough room for her niece and her niece's daughter to live with the family.“There was a yard to play in, and it reminded me of my home in Galveston, a place for all the kids to hang out. ‘You can have parties with all your friends,’ I’d told the girls,” she wrote.Harris County deed records show that the Knowles family bought the residence in 1987 and owned it until 1994. It has since passed through several owners, with each making changes to the property over the years.Tour bus during the house's open viewingWhen the house was listed for sale, Yvonne Bonner-Holley, the Keller Williams Realty agent handling the property, told the Houston Chronicle that fans from different parts of the United States contacted her about the house.The agent said she had to establish which enquiries came from serious prospective buyers. She held only one open house, but the event drew a large crowd. Towards the end, a tour bus arrived carrying fans who wanted to look inside. They were turned away.The property's owners had previously placed a life-size cutout of Beyonce outside the house, allowing visitors to take photographs. However, they also asked fans to respect the fact that people lived there and that the property was not a museum.Bonner-Holley also said the house also appealed to buyers because of its location. It stands on a tree-lined street with large residential plots and is close to Parkwood Park.Houston neighbourhood where Beyonce grew upThe neighbourhood was developed during the 1920s and 1930s and is known for its large houses, several of which were built before the Second World War.During the 1950s, Black families began purchasing properties in Riverside Terrace while facing discriminatory housing practices in other parts of Houston, including River Oaks. By the 1960s, the area had become an important residential neighbourhood for Black professionals and business leaders.Bonner-Holley said some architects who worked on houses in River Oaks also designed homes in Riverside Terrace, occasionally using similar floor plans. Several of those older properties remain standing.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? Build Your Legacy with TOI Homes.

articles.title: Former Japan PM Yasuo Fukuda, the country’s first second-generation leader, dies at 90
articles.summary: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who sought to strengthen diplomatic relations with China during his brief tenure in office, has died at the
articles.body: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who sought to strengthen diplomatic relations with China during his brief tenure in office, has died at the age of 90, a ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) official confirmed on Monday.Fukuda died on October 22, with Japanese business daily Nikkei reporting heart failure as the cause of death.He served as Japan's prime minister from September 2007 to September 2008, taking office after Shinzo Abe abruptly resigned following his first year as premier. Fukuda became the first son of a former Japanese prime minister to hold the country's top political office, following his father, Takeo Fukuda, who led Japan from 1976 to 1978.During his year in power, Fukuda prioritised improving relations with Japan's Asian neighbours, particularly China, at a time when historical disputes and regional tensions had strained ties between the two countries.In May 2008, he hosted then Chinese President Hu Jintao on a landmark visit to Japan, the first by a Chinese head of state in a decade. The two leaders issued a joint statement pledging to develop a “mutually beneficial relationship based on common strategic interests”.However, Fukuda's domestic political challenges overshadowed his diplomatic efforts. Facing a divided parliament, legislative gridlock and declining public approval, he announced his resignation in September 2008, less than a year after assuming office.Before becoming prime minister, Fukuda had built a long career in both business and politics. An economics graduate from Waseda University, he spent nearly two decades working for an oil company, including a posting in the United States, before entering politics as his father's secretary in 1976.He was first elected to Japan's lower house of parliament in 1990 and later served as chief cabinet secretary between 2000 and 2004. He resigned from that position after acknowledging that he had failed to make required pension contributions.Fukuda retired from electoral politics in 2012 but remained active in diplomacy, particularly in efforts to ease tensions between Tokyo and Beijing.In 2014, amid worsening relations over disputed islands and historical grievances, he travelled to China for talks with President Xi Jinping. The meeting helped pave the way for a summit between Xi and Abe, who had returned to power for a second term.Known for his preference for dialogue and engagement in foreign policy, Fukuda continued advocating closer relations between the two Asian powers after leaving office.He is survived by his son, Tatsuo Fukuda, a Japanese lawmaker who has also been regarded as a potential future prime minister.You use AI every day. articles.title: Bhopal Metro burns Rs 50 lakh in a week, takes over 100 days to earn it back
articles.summary: BHOPAL: Bhopal Metro spends nearly Rs 50 lakh on operations and maintenance in about a week, but could take more than 100 days to earn that amount from
articles.body: BHOPAL: Bhopal Metro spends nearly Rs 50 lakh on operations and maintenance in about a week, but could take more than 100 days to earn that amount from ticket sales, according to estimates based on operating costs and passenger numbers.The gap persists as the service struggles to attract commuters on its nearly seven-km priority corridor, while efforts to generate revenue beyond tickets remain a work in progress.Costs outpace earnings: Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd managing director S Krishna Chaitanya estimated annual operating and maintenance costs at Rs 20-25 crore. That works out to roughly Rs 5.5-6.8 lakh daily, or Rs 38-48 lakh weekly.Estimated weekday ridership of 150-500 and weekend footfall of up to 1,500, combined with an assumed average fare of Rs 50, suggest ticket earnings fall well short of expenditure. These calculations are indicative, not audited revenue figures.The corporation's public relations officer did not provide current passenger numbers. Daily trips have increased from nine to around 20 since July, but updated data was unavailable to establish whether the additional services had boosted ridership.Limited reach: The eight-station corridor between AIIMS and Subhash Nagar opened in Dec 2025. Its limited reach restricts its usefulness for daily commuters. "Wider network coverage is expected only by 2028," Chaitanya said.Early passenger figures reflected a stronger weekend response. Ridership stood at 275 on Jan 15 but approached 1,000 on Jan 18, a Sunday. Between Jan 13 and 20, trains carried 3,350 passengers. These figures relate to the initial operating period, not current usage.Beyond the farebox: The corporation has explored advertising, semi-naming rights, commercial leases, coaching spaces and private events to supplement ticket revenue. A tender to lease advertising space on more than 700 elevated-line pillars was issued in Nov 2025.Introduced in May, "Celebration on Wheels" offers coaches and selected station areas for birthdays, pre-wedding shoots, film shoots and other events. The response was limited, with two Indore bookings over four weeks and a cancelled Bhopal booking by early June.Bhopal hosted a fitness group's event on June 7, but such bookings have yet to establish a dependable income stream.Around 620 sq m at Board Office Chauraha and approximately 2,470 sq m at Subhash Nagar were listed for commercial leasing in June. articles.title: October records highest number of ship attacks in Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: October has emerged as the deadliest month for commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waterways, according to data compiled by a
articles.body: October has emerged as the deadliest month for commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waterways, according to data compiled by a Washington-based think tank that has monitored maritime security incidents worldwide since 2017.“October has seen the highest number of ship attacks on record,” said Noam Raydan, a senior fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy.Raydan, who maintains the institute’s interactive map of shipping incidents, has documented 28 confirmed and reported attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and surrounding waterways in October. The total number of such incidents has reached 113 since the US-Israeli war with Iran began on February 28.The institute’s data indicates that most attacks recorded in September and October occurred in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the news agency Reuters.Around 3.5% of global supertanker fleet targetedThe figures broadly correspond with data from the International Maritime Organization (IMO), which has recorded 120 incidents across the Strait of Hormuz and the wider middle east since the conflict with Iran began.A Reuters review of the IMO’s records and marine traffic vessel data found that more than 30 supertankers, also known as Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs), were damaged in the attacks. Eleven of these vessels were hit in October alone.Each VLCC can transport approximately 2 million barrels of crude oil. The affected vessels represent around 3.5% of the global VLCC fleet, which comprises more than 900 ships.The number of tankers targeted increased as shipowners showed greater willingness to load cargoes within the Gulf. They were attracted by daily freight rates exceeding $1 million and larger discounts offered by regional oil producers against dated Brent prices.Greece-based consultancy Marisks said October 2026 had become the most intense period for maritime attacks in and around the Strait of Hormuz since hostilities escalated in March.It added that 12 ships came under attack between October 5 and October 11, marking the highest weekly total since the conflict began.Maritime attack figures may be incompleteAccording to Raydan, Iran is escalating attacks to hamper the recovery of shipping activity and sustain pressure on global energy markets ahead of the US midterm elections in November.Earlier this month, Reuters reported that Tehran was adopting such tactics, citing two senior Iranian officials.The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), the British maritime security service, reported 135 incidents linked to the US-Iran conflict as of October 16. However, the agency said a lack of voluntary reporting from shipping companies was making it difficult to establish the full extent of the attacks.UKMTO data also pointed to a sharp increase in damage to commercial vessels caused by attacks during October.You use AI every day.
